description: Chronos personal-scoped pipeline runner. Entered ONLY in the child process chronos spawns for a schedule discovered under knowledge/personal/pipelines/ (and, in the daemon, synchronously while listing/reading those pipeline files). No tenant binding — reads cover the operator's personal pipeline directory and its runtime allowlist; writes cover the volatile layer those personal pipelines own plus the shared pipeline-runner surface (traces, tmp, observability, coordination). Runs require an exact-content project-trust approval, like tenant pipelines.
